qualityObjective.en:
Provide a clean, sound, dry, level, properly profiled concrete substrate suitable for the specified floor finish system.
A large percentage of floor-finish failures originate in poor substrate preparation rather than the finish material itself.

qualityObjective.en:
This module should branch by system because tile, resilient flooring and epoxy behave very differently.
TILE: Install tile with the correct product, layout, substrate preparation, bonding coverage, alignment, joint spacing, movement joints and finish.
RESILIENT FLOORING: Install resilient flooring over a properly prepared, dry, smooth substrate with correct adhesive, seams, layout and transitions.
EPOXY / FLOOR COATINGS: Apply the approved floor-coating system to a properly prepared substrate under acceptable environmental conditions at the required thickness and finish.
qualityObjective.fr: cela module devrait branch par system because tile, resilient flooring et epoxy behave very differently. TILE: installer tile avec le corriger product, layout, support preparation, bonding coverage, alignement, joint spacing, movement joints et finish. RESILIENT FLOORING: installer resilient flooring over a correctement prepared, dry, lisser support avec corriger adhésif, seams, layout et transitions. EPOXY / FLOOR COATINGS: Apply le approuvé floor-enduit system à a correctement prepared support sous acceptable environmental conditions à le requis thickness et finish.
